title: B1 highlight-radius fix is golden-only — no unit pin for the 8-tile tile-unit bound
evidence: spawn_fx.odin:454 `rad := f32(SPAWN_HIGHLIGHT_RADIUS_TILES)` ... :469 `if dx * dx + dy * dy > rad * rad {` (B1 fix verified tile-units both sides). spawn_fx_test.odin pin list ends: "(f) PENDING COMMANDS — the shadow applies the caller's pending slice at the apply ticks (the harness path — a demo draw between tick and the window must move the prediction exactly like the live sim)." — `grep -rn "highlight" app/render/*_test.odin` returns nothing; no test references SPAWN_HIGHLIGHT_RADIUS_TILES.
detail: Round-1 blocker B1 was already blessed into goldens once; pixel goldens exercise but do not pin the bound — any future re-bless silently accepts a wrong radius. The 8-tile invariant lacks the lowest-layer pin the project's testing rule requires.
recommended_fix: Pin the predicate at unit level: topology with pipe midpoints at 7/8/9 tiles from a reveal, assert exactly the in-radius pipes selected (or extract the distance filter into a testable helper).

title: Reveal-buffer >4 trim boundary still untested (r1 carry-forward, re-verified present)
evidence:
spawn_fx.odin:153-154:
`for len(fx.reveals) > 4 {`
`ordered_remove(&fx.reveals, 0)` — the largest feed in any test is spawn_fx_test.odin:375 `testing.expectf(t, len(v.spawn_fx.reveals) == 2, "two events -> two reveals, got %d", len(v.spawn_fx.reveals))`; ordered_remove appears in no test file.
detail: A pause/catch-up frame delivers multiple windows' NODE_SPAWNED events in one slice; the bounded-buffer guard (the only defense against unbounded reveals growth) is never exercised by any test.
recommended_fix: Append five NODE_SPAWNED events in one slice, call spawn_fx_feed, assert len(reveals)==4 and the oldest (lowest-id) entry evicted.

title: Reduced-motion telegraph ring and highlight branches have zero coverage — no unit pin, no growth-enabled a11y golden
evidence: spawn_fx_draw_highlight opens: `spawn_fx_draw_highlight :: proc(v: ^View, topo: ^pp.Topology, tick: u64) {` / `if v.reduced_motion {` / `return` — an untested branch (and divergent from the documented 'steady band'); the telegraph's static-ring branch is likewise untested. demos/a11y_reduced.dem (the only reduced-motion golden) contains `a11y reduced` / `seed 7` / `run 70000ms` / `era 3` / `fixture off` and no `growth on` directive, so no NODE_SPAWNED events ever occur under reduced motion.
detail: The only reduced-motion spawn-fx pin is spawn_fx_reveal_transform (unit). The static-ring branch and the highlight early-return are invisible to every test, so the E9.2 contract regresses silently.
recommended_fix: Unit-pin reduced_motion behavior (ring pinned static radius/alpha, highlight presence per the resolved W1 divergence) or add a growth-enabled reduced-motion demo golden.

title: Topology-gen re-predict clause (mid-window retarget) untested
evidence: spawn_fx_predict dedup guard: `if !force && fx.predicted_window == window && fx.predicted_gen == state.topology.gen {` / `return // already predicted for this window + topology`. test_spawn_fx_predict_dedup only calls `spawn_fx_predict(&v, &s, &cat, 75, {}, false)` then `spawn_fx_predict(&v, &s, &cat, 76, {}, false)` on the same unchanged state — topology.gen never varies between calls.
detail: The advertised mid-window retarget ('a player edit bumps the topology gen — the ring retargets within a frame') has no test; a dropped gen clause strands a stale ring for up to 10 ticks.
recommended_fix: In the dedup test, apply an edit (bump topology.gen) between non-forced predicts and assert the telegraph recomputes for the same window.
